title: SCAPI | B2C Commerce API
snippet:
The B2C Commerce API (SCAPI) is a set of RESTful APIs for building storefronts, merchant tools, and integrations on the B2C Commerce platform. It also goes by “Salesforce Commerce API” or just “Commerce API.” For B2C Commerce customers, the API is available at no extra cost.
To browse the endpoints, see the [API Reference](/docs/commerce/commerce-api/references/about-commerce-api/about.html). To learn how SCAPI fits into the B2C Commerce stack, see [Composable Storefront and SCAPI](https://developer.salesforce.com/docs/commerce/pwa-kit-managed-runtime/guide/pwa-scapi.html).

title: Commerce Cloud
snippet:
Salesforce Commerce Cloud offers distinct solutions for B2B/D2C (business-to-business and direct-to-consumer) and B2C (business-to-consumer) commerce. B2B and D2C Commerce solutions focus on complex order and account management, advanced personalization, and enterprise integration. B2C Commerce emphasizes high-volume transactions, customer engagement, seamless mobile-optimized checkout, and real-time inventory management.

### B2C Commerce API (SCAPI)
Use a headless API to build custom apps. B2C Commerce API is also known as Salesforce Commerce API (SCAPI). Applies to: Composable, hybrid, and custom.

### Open Commerce API (OCAPI)
Access B2C Commerce data (such as product and shopper data) and functionality (such as baskets and orders) through secure and well-defined API methods. Applies to: Composable, SFRA, hybrid, and custom.

Explore content for Point of Sale (POS) implementations. Extend your POS operations with comprehensive APIs, SPIs, and webhooks that enable seamless integration with external systems.

title: About | B2C Commerce API
snippet:
Use B2C Commerce API (also known as Salesforce Commerce API or SCAPI) to build headless commerce experiences.
- For status updates and trust notifications, go to the [B2C Commerce Status Page](https://status.salesforce.com/products/B2C_Commerce_Cloud).

- To **browse the API endpoints**, use the left navigation. B2C Commerce API is broken into two main groups: Shopper APIs and Admin APIs. All Shopper API groups start with *Shopper*. For details about the differences, see [Get Started](https://developer.salesforce.com/docs/commerce/commerce-api/guide).

- [Sites API](https://developer.salesforce.com/docs/commerce/commerce-api/references/sites?meta=Summary)
- GET `/sites`
- Retrieve details for all sites.
- GET `/sites/{siteId}` - Retrieve site details by ID.
- POST `/site-search`
- Search sites.
